mapper.select: SELECT id, name, name_normalized, uscc, business_status FROM ent_enterprise WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ent_enterprise WHERE name_normalized = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ent_enterprise_verification(enterprise_id, source, order_ref, is_demo, result_status, verified_name, verified_uscc, business_status, registered_address, reason) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{source}, #{orderRef}, #{demo}, #{status}, #{name}, #{uscc}, #{businessStatus}, #{address}, #{reason}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT id, enterprise_id, source, order_ref, is_demo, result_status, verified_name, verified_uscc, business_status, registered_address, reason, verified_at FROM ent_enterprise_verification WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, source, verified_at, verified_name, verified_uscc, business_status, registered_address, CASE WHEN verified_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN reason ELSE '核验结果已超过30天有效期，需重新核实' END AS reason, CASE WHEN verified_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN result_status ELSE 'PENDING' END AS verification_status, CASE WHEN verified_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS verification_fresh FROM ent_enterprise_verification WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND is_demo = FALSE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
